The '''Mekhis Aggression Index''' was a psychological measurement test, named after [[Darth Mekhis]], that measured an individual's predisposition towards violence and their effectiveness at channeling hostility during combat. The [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] [[Treek/Legends|Treek]] received a perfect score.
